title: Foundations for nighttime lights data analysis
description: NighttimeLights.jl is a Julia package for cleaning and bias-correcting monthly nighttime lights from the Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS). It provides composable functions for missing-value recoding, interpolation, negative-value handling, outlier removal, background-noise filtering, and cloud-cover bias correction, together with standard pipelines that compose them into analysis-ready data cubes.
